overall.note: toward_behavior = commitment of the held-cell read toward the pair's safety behavior, in nats; >0 = the fine-tune committed to the behavior, <0 = it followed the style/partner. Orientation per pair (all 22 have behavior as f2, so toward_behavior = -heldout_raw). shift = named - neutral (matched layout). flip = bare-neutral loses (<0) AND named_first wins (>0). seeds [0,1].
